column2: Cognitive dissonance made him uneasy: he cared about the planet, yet he drove a gas-guzzling truck every day.
column3: 認知失調讓他很不安：他關心地球，卻天天開著耗油的卡車。
column4: feel cognitive dissonance (感到認知失調)
column5: dissonance 是不和諧的音，腦中兩個想法唱反調，像走音
column7: cog - ni - tive dis - so - nance

column2: Our perception of color depends on how the brain interprets the light that enters the eye.
column3: 我們對顏色的感知，取決於大腦如何詮釋進入眼睛的光線。
column5: per 透過 + cept 接收，像 receive，透過感官接收再理解

column2: Sensory neurons in the fingertips send signals to the brain whenever something feels hot or rough.
column3: 指尖的感覺神經元在東西摸起來燙或粗糙時，會把訊號送往大腦。
column5: sense 感覺 + ory 的，跟感覺有關的

column2: A sudden loud noise is a stimulus that makes a baby's arms fly outward.
column3: 突然的巨響是一種刺激，會讓嬰兒的雙臂向外彈開。
column4: respond to a stimulus (對刺激做出反應)
column5: stimulus 像 stimulate 刺激，貼心地戳一下讓你有反應

column2: The patient's response to the medicine was quick: her fever dropped within an hour.
column3: 病人對藥物的反應很快：她的燒在一小時內就退了。
column4: response to treatment (對治療的反應)
column5: re 回 + spond 承諾，別人問一下就回一下

column2: Subconscious fears can shape our choices even when we are not aware of them.
column3: 潛意識的恐懼，即使我們沒有察覺，也能左右我們的選擇。
column5: sub 在下面 + conscious 有意識的，意識底下的地下室

column2: After the fall, the cyclist lay unconscious on the road until paramedics arrived.
column3: 摔倒後，那位自行車騎士昏迷地躺在路上，直到救護人員抵達。
column5: un 沒有 + conscious 有意識的；sub 是在下面，un 是完全沒有

column2: Choosing the restaurant with the longest line is a simple heuristic that often saves time.
column3: 選擇排隊最長的餐廳是個簡單的捷思法，常能省下時間。
column4: a simple heuristic (簡單的捷思法)
column5: heuristic 念起來像 Eureka 找到了，用小竅門快速找到答案

column2: Her intuition told her the deal was too good to be true, and she was right.
column3: 她的直覺告訴她這筆交易好得不像真的，結果她說對了。
column4: trust your intuition (相信你的直覺)
column5: in 內心 + tuit 看，不用推理，內心直接看見答案

column2: The wise old mentor is a common archetype that appears in myths, fairy tales, and modern films.
column3: 睿智的老導師是常見的原型，出現在神話、童話和現代電影中。
column5: arche 最初 + type 類型，最原始的那個模板

column2: A newborn sea turtle follows its instinct and heads straight for the ocean.
column3: 剛出生的海龜憑著本能直奔大海。
column5: in 裡面本來就有的衝動，不用人教就會做

column2: Peer pressure encourages conformity, as teenagers dress alike to avoid standing out from the group.
column3: 同儕壓力助長從眾行為，青少年為了不在團體中顯得突出而穿得一樣。
column5: con 一起 + form 形狀，大家變成同一個形狀

column2: Strict compliance with safety rules is required before anyone may enter the laboratory.
column3: 任何人進入實驗室之前，都必須嚴格遵守安全規定。
column4: compliance with the rules (遵守規定)
column5: comply 照辦 + ance，老師說完，你回答：好，我照辦

column2: In Milgram's experiment, many volunteers showed surprising obedience to an authority figure in a lab coat.
column3: 在米爾格蘭的實驗中，許多受試者對穿著實驗袍的權威人物表現出令人驚訝的服從。
column5: ob 朝向 + ey 聽，朝著權威的方向乖乖聽話

column2: Moving to a huge city alone left her with a deep sense of alienation from those around her.
column3: 獨自搬到大城市，使她對周遭的人產生深深的疏離感。
column5: alien 外星人，覺得自己像外星人，和大家格格不入

column2: Anthropology students spend years comparing how different cultures raise children and honor their ancestors.
column3: 人類學的學生花好幾年比較不同文化如何養育孩子、尊崇祖先。
column5: anthrop 人 + ology 學問，研究人類的學問

column2: Her ethnography was based on two years of living in a fishing village and recording daily life.
column3: 她的民族誌建立在兩年的漁村生活和日常記錄之上。
column5: ethno 民族 + graph 書寫，把一個民族寫下來

column2: The Armenian diaspora includes millions who live outside their homeland, from Paris to Los Angeles.
column3: 亞美尼亞人的離散社群包括數百萬居住在家鄉之外的人，從巴黎到洛杉磯都有。
column4: member of the diaspora (離散族群成員)
column5: dia 穿過 + spora 撒種子，族群像種子被撒到世界各地

column2: In a medieval hierarchy, kings ranked above nobles, and nobles above peasants.
column3: 在中世紀的階級體系中，國王高於貴族，貴族又高於農民。
column5: hier 神聖 + arch 統治，一層層往上，像金字塔

column2: The tribe had an egalitarian culture in which every adult had an equal voice in decisions.
column3: 這個部落有平等主義的文化，每位成人在決策上都有同等的發言權。
column5: egal 來自 equal 平等，人人都一樣高
column7: e - gal - i - tar - i - an

column2: A sedentary lifestyle, spent mostly sitting at a desk, raises the risk of heart disease.
column3: 大部分時間坐在桌前的久坐生活方式，會增加罹患心臟病的風險。
column5: sed 是坐，像 session 開會要坐著，一直坐著不動

column2: The nomadic herders move their sheep to new grassland each season, carrying their tents with them.
column3: 游牧的牧民每季都把羊群趕到新的草地，並隨身帶著帳篷。
column5: nomadic 諧音「諾馬迪克」，逐水草而居、四處搬家的人

column2: Pastoral societies raise herds of cattle and goats instead of growing crops.
column3: 畜牧社會飼養牛群和山羊，而不是種植作物。
column5: pastor 原意是牧羊人，帶領羊群的人，+ al 的

column2: The agrarian economy of the valley depended on wheat, barley, and the yearly flooding of the river.
column3: 這個河谷的農業經濟依賴小麥、大麥和河水每年的氾濫。
column5: agr 是田地，像 agriculture 農業，+ arian 的

column2: As hunter-gatherers, early humans moved with the seasons to find animals to hunt and plants to collect.
column3: 身為採集狩獵者，早期人類隨季節遷移，尋找可獵捕的動物和可採集的植物。
column5: hunter 獵人 + gatherer 採集者，又打獵又撿果子

column2: Each morning the forager wandered the woods, filling a basket with berries, nuts, and wild herbs.
column3: 採集者每天早上在樹林裡漫步，把野莓、堅果和野生香草裝滿一籃子。
column5: forage 覓食 + er 做事的人，到處撿食物的人

column2: Among the islanders, kinship determines who may marry whom and who inherits the family land.
column3: 在島民之間，親屬關係決定誰可以嫁娶誰，以及誰繼承家族土地。
column5: kin 親人 + ship 關係，像 friendship，親人之間的連結

column2: In a matrilineal society, a child belongs to the mother's clan and inherits through her family.
column3: 在母系社會裡，孩子屬於母親的氏族，並透過母親的家族繼承財產。
column5: matri 母親，像 maternal，lineal 血統線，沿著媽媽這條線傳下去

column2: The family name passes along a patrilineal line, from father to son across many generations.
column3: 姓氏沿著父系一脈傳承，世世代代由父親傳給兒子。
column5: patri 父親，像 paternal，lineal 血統線，沿著爸爸這條線傳下去

column2: In a matriarchy, women hold the main positions of power and leadership in the community.
column3: 在母權社會中，女性擔任社群裡主要的權力與領導職位。
column4: live in a matriarchy (生活在母權社會)
column5: matri 母親 + archy 統治，像 monarchy，媽媽當家作主

column2: Historians describe ancient Rome as a patriarchy, since only men could vote or hold high office.
column3: 歷史學家把古羅馬描述為父權社會，因為只有男性能投票或擔任高官。
column4: challenge the patriarchy (挑戰父權體制)
column5: patri 父親 + archy 統治，爸爸當家作主

column2: Swans are known for monogamy, often staying with a single partner for life.
column3: 天鵝以一夫一妻聞名，常終生只守著一個伴侶。
column5: mono 單一 + gamy 婚姻，只有一位伴侶

column2: Polygamy, in which a man has several wives, is illegal in most countries today.
column3: 一夫多妻制，即一名男子有數位妻子，在現今大多數國家是違法的。
column5: poly 多 + gamy 婚姻，像 polygon 多邊形，伴侶有好幾位

column2: Each Scottish clan had its own tartan pattern and a chief who led its members.
column3: 蘇格蘭的每個氏族都有自己的格紋圖案，以及領導族人的族長。
column5: clan 和 plan 只差一個字母，家族大事大家一起商量

column2: Members of the tribe gather around a fire to share stories and celebrate the harvest.
column3: 部落成員圍著營火分享故事，並慶祝豐收。
column5: tribe 和 bribe 只差一個字母，部落裡大家是一家，不用賄賂

column2: The chieftain settled disputes between families and led warriors whenever a neighboring tribe threatened the village.
column3: 酋長調解家族之間的糾紛，並在鄰近部落威脅村莊時率領戰士。
column5: chief 首領 + tain，領頭的那個人

column2: Lighting a candle and bowing is a daily ritual at the temple.
column3: 點蠟燭並鞠躬，是寺廟裡每天的儀式。
column5: ritual 諧音「瑞求有」，一步一步固定重複的神聖儀式

column2: Receiving a driver's license is a rite of passage for many American teenagers.
column3: 拿到駕照是許多美國青少年的成年儀式。
column5: rite 儀式 + passage 通過，穿過一道人生的大門

column2: Greek mythology tells how Zeus ruled the gods from Mount Olympus.
column3: 希臘神話敘述宙斯如何從奧林帕斯山統治眾神。
column5: myth 神話 + ology 學問，一整套神話故事集

column2: According to local folklore, a friendly spirit lives in the old oak tree at the edge of the village.
column3: 根據當地的民間傳說，一位友善的精靈住在村莊邊那棵老橡樹裡。
column5: folk 民眾 + lore 知識傳說，老百姓口耳相傳的故事
